messages.text: What are the most important signaling test capabilities for applications in Automotive?

【推論】The best-supported automotive priority is NG eCall over IMS/4G/5G, because the passages directly connect Snapdragon Auto, EN 17240:2024 NG eCall verification, PSAP simulation, and R&S CMX500 with CMX-KA098 under realistic network conditions [35].
NG eCall testing is directly automotive-relevant because R&S and Qualcomm verified a Next Generation eCall implementation on the Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF using the R&S CMX500 mobile radio tester [35].
EN 17240:2024 is described as guidelines for testing eCall systems on IMS networks with 4G LTE and 5G NR technologies [35].
R&S CMX500 is described as a comprehensive testing solution for NG eCall voice and data transmission [35].
The NG eCall verification simulated a PSAP and verified implementation at both ends against EN 17240:2024 [35].
R&S CMX500 with the CMX-KA098 software option can be used for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions [35].
The CMX500 NGeCall 4G/5G configuration marks CMX-KA098 as mandatory for 4G/5G NG eCall 17240:2024 [56].
The CMX500 NGeCall 4G/5G configuration marks CMX-KA110 as mandatory for IMS tests from EN 17240:2024 [56].
The CMX500 NGeCall 4G/5G configuration marks CMX-KA401 as mandatory for TS17240 In-Band Modem over IP tests [56].
The CMX500 NGeCall 4G/5G configuration marks CMX-KF671B as mandatory for 4G/5G NG eCall 17240:2024 end-to-end test scripts [56].
【推論】Hybrid eCall fallback signaling is also a key automotive focus, because the passages describe vehicle emergency call reliability across NG eCall, classic CS eCall, fallback, degraded radio conditions, handovers, VoNR, and VoLTE [50][53][54].
Hybrid eCall testing verifies that a vehicle emergency call system can operate reliably between NG eCall and classic CS eCall transport paths [54].
EN 18052 requires hybrid systems to combine different transmission paths and protocols so that eCall reliably reaches its destination [50].
Manufacturers need to validate call triggering, MSD transmission, GNSS positioning maintenance, and intelligible voice quality [50].
Hybrid eCall scenarios include VoNR, VoLTE, circuit-switched fallback, handovers, degraded radio conditions, real-world mobile network condition simulation, and various network scenario emulation [53].
The CMX500 hybrid minimum configuration includes CMX-KS600B as mandatory LTE/NR signaling enabler Rel.15 basic level [55].
The CMX500 hybrid minimum configuration includes CMX-KA098 as mandatory enabling test software for 4G/5G NGeCall [55].
The CMX500 hybrid minimum configuration includes CMX-KA099 as mandatory APPL NGECALL MULTI CELL [55].
The CMX500 hybrid minimum configuration includes CMX-KF672B as mandatory NGECALL TC EN18052 [55].
Important NGeCall signaling test topics include IVS manual eCall, automatic eCall, and test eCall initiation [60].
Important NGeCall signaling test topics include IMS eCall session establishment for automatic, manual, and test eCall service URNs [60].
Important NGeCall signaling test topics include MSD transfer, MSD update, PSAP request, negative acknowledgement, and missing acknowledgement scenarios [60].
Important NGeCall signaling test topics include valid SIM/USIM, forbidden PLMN, limited service condition, and roaming scenarios [60].
Important NGeCall signaling test topics include PSAP initiated callback, call clear-down, and IVS initiated clear-down not allowed [60].
Important NGeCall signaling test topics include voice link establishment and audio interface verification [60].
Important NGeCall signaling test topics include eCall only mode, T3444/T3445, and SRVCC handover to CS domain, UTRAN, or GERAN [60].
CMX500 NGeCall sources add 5GS/NR-related 3GPP TS 34.229-5 and 3GPP TS 38.523-1 test contexts [60].
CMX500 NGeCall sources add CEN EN 17240:2024 IPv4/IPv6 MSD transfer, MSD version 3, and additional data from Euro NCAP TB 040:2022 [60].
Automotive is listed as an application context for Virtual Signalling Tester post-silicon testing [25].
Virtual Signalling Tester post-silicon testing supports basic protocol tests for IoT devices and communication modules [25].
Virtual Signalling Tester post-silicon testing supports fast functional tests, regression tests, sample scenario parameterization, test procedures, and report/log display [25].
Virtual Signalling Tester is a PC-based software protocol simulator for creating an NR/RedCap protocol test environment [26].
Virtual Signalling Tester reproduces RRC-NAS, PDCP, RLC, and MAC protocol layers on a PC [28].
【推論】For broader automotive connectivity beyond eCall, the supported signaling building blocks are LTE/NR, RedCap/eRedCap, NTN, and WLAN, but the passages do not directly tie each of these general CMX500 options to automotive use [1][47][48].
R&S CMX500 supports LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD device testing [1].
R&S CMX500 supports NR FR1/FR2 signaling and LTE signaling [1].
The NR signaling enabler CMX-KS600B/M/X includes 5G NR SA option 2, NSA option 3, DL 2x2 and 4x4 MIMO, one CC, and UL 256QAM [47].
The NR signaling extension CMX-KS610B/M/X includes UL 2x2 MIMO and carrier aggregation up to 9 CC [47].
The NR signaling extension CMX-KS612B/M/X provides carrier aggregation from 10 to 12 CC [47].
RedCap is supported by CMX-KS617B/M/X, and eRedCap is supported by CMX-KS618B/X [47].
NTN signaling extensions are supported by CMX-KS627B/M/X, CMX-KS628B/X, and CMX-KS629B/X [47].
NB-NTN signaling Rel.17 is supported by CMX-KS527B/X [47].
WLAN signaling supports 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be, 802.11bn, AP testing, station testing, single-user 2x2 MIMO, and advanced encryption and authentication [48].

【推論】For broader automotive connectivity beyond eCall, the supported signaling building blocks are LTE/NR, RedCap/eRedCap, NTN, and WLAN, but the passages do not directly tie each of these general CMX500 options to automotive use [1][47][48].
R&S CMX500 supports LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD device testing [1].
R&S CMX500 supports NR FR1/FR2 signaling and LTE signaling [1].
The NR signaling enabler CMX-KS600B/M/X includes 5G NR SA option 2, NSA option 3, DL 2x2 and 4x4 MIMO, one CC, and UL 256QAM [47].
The NR signaling extension CMX-KS610B/M/X includes UL 2x2 MIMO and carrier aggregation up to 9 CC [47].
The NR signaling extension CMX-KS612B/M/X provides carrier aggregation from 10 to 12 CC [47].
RedCap is supported by CMX-KS617B/M/X, and eRedCap is supported by CMX-KS618B/X [47].
NTN signaling extensions are supported by CMX-KS627B/M/X, CMX-KS628B/X, and CMX-KS629B/X [47].
NB-NTN signaling Rel.17 is supported by CMX-KS527B/X [47].
WLAN signaling supports 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be, 802.11bn, AP testing, station testing, single-user 2x2 MIMO, and advanced encryption and authentication [48].

Important NGeCall signaling test topics include PSAP initiated callback, call clear-down, and IVS initiated clear-down not allowed [60].
Important NGeCall signaling test topics include voice link establishment and audio interface verification [60].
Important NGeCall signaling test topics include eCall only mode, T3444/T3445, and SRVCC handover to CS domain, UTRAN, or GERAN [60].
CMX500 NGeCall sources add 5GS/NR-related 3GPP TS 34.229-5 and 3GPP TS 38.523-1 test contexts [60].
CMX500 NGeCall sources add CEN EN 17240:2024 IPv4/IPv6 MSD transfer, MSD version 3, and additional data from Euro NCAP TB 040:2022 [60].
Automotive is listed as an application context for Virtual Signalling Tester post-silicon testing [25].
Virtual Signalling Tester post-silicon testing supports basic protocol tests for IoT devices and communication modules [25].
Virtual Signalling Tester post-silicon testing supports fast functional tests, regression tests, sample scenario parameterization, test procedures, and report/log display [25].
Virtual Signalling Tester is a PC-based software protocol simulator for creating an NR/RedCap protocol test environment [26].
Virtual Signalling Tester reproduces RRC-NAS, PDCP, RLC, and MAC protocol layers on a PC [28].
【推論】For broader automotive connectivity beyond eCall, the supported signaling building blocks are LTE/NR, RedCap/eRedCap, NTN, and WLAN, but the passages do not directly tie each of these general CMX500 options to automotive use [1][47][48].
R&S CMX500 supports LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD device testing [1].
R&S CMX500 supports NR FR1/FR2 signaling and LTE signaling [1].
The NR signaling enabler CMX-KS600B/M/X includes 5G NR SA option 2, NSA option 3, DL 2x2 and 4x4 MIMO, one CC, and UL 256QAM [47].
The NR signaling extension CMX-KS610B/M/X includes UL 2x2 MIMO and carrier aggregation up to 9 CC [47].
The NR signaling extension CMX-KS612B/M/X provides carrier aggregation from 10 to 12 CC [47].
RedCap is supported by CMX-KS617B/M/X, and eRedCap is supported by CMX-KS618B/X [47].
NTN signaling extensions are supported by CMX-KS627B/M/X, CMX-KS628B/X, and CMX-KS629B/X [47].
NB-NTN signaling Rel.17 is supported by CMX-KS527B/X [47].
WLAN signaling supports 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be, 802.11bn, AP testing, station testing, single-user 2x2 MIMO, and advanced encryption and authentication [48].

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

Virtual Signalling Tester › Post-silicon testing
- 適用 [[IoT]] device 與 communication module 的 basic protocol test。
- 支援快速 functional test、regression test、sample scenario parameterization、test procedure 與 report / log display。
- 來源列出 [[5G RedCap]]、Automotive、Healthcare、Industrial IoT、Smart Cities 等應用語境。

Virtual Signalling Tester
[[Virtual Signalling Tester]] 是 [[mx844030pc-j1200]] 中 Anritsu 對 virtualized protocol stack test solution 的產品 / 解決方案語彙，核心是用 PC-based software protocol simulator 建立 NR / RedCap protocol test environment。

Virtual Signalling Tester › 來源定義
[[mx844030pc-j1200]] 將 [[Virtual Signalling Tester]] 描述為 software protocol simulator / Virtual Signalling Test Solution，透過虛擬化 protocol stack，在 PC 上重現多個 protocol layers：

- [[RRC-NAS]]
- [[PDCP]]
- [[RLC]]
- [[MAC]]

來源主張它可不使用一般硬體測試儀而在 PC 上快速建立 protocol test environment；但 RF-IF configuration 仍使用 [[Anritsu MD8190A]] Universal RF Unit 與 [[MX819020A]] RF Platform。

Rohde & Schwarz verifies Next Generation eCall for EN 17240_2024 Standard › 重點摘要
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 宣稱其與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] 合作，驗證 [[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 上 [[Next Generation eCall]]（NG eCall）的 implementation，並稱其符合 [[EN 17240]]:2024。
- 來源說 [[eCall]] 於 2015 年導入，且自 2018 年起成為歐盟境內所有新車銷售的 mandatory requirement。
- 來源指出，隨著 2G / 3G circuit-switched cellular networks 逐漸 obsolete，emergency call systems 需要適配到 4G / 5G packet-switched cellular networks。
- 來源稱 [[European Commission]] 在其 most recent regulation 中定義 NG eCall 將自 **2026-01-01** 起成為 obligatory。
- 來源稱 EN 17240:2024 建立在 IP Multimedia Subsystem（[[IMS]]）networks 上測試 eCall systems 的 guidelines，涵蓋 advanced 4G LTE 與 5G NR technologies。
- [[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 被描述為 5G automotive-grade platform，支援 high-speed connectivity、advanced positioning、Vehicle-to-Everything（[[V2X]]）、multi-band [[GNSS]] navigation 與 enhanced safety。
- 來源稱驗證流程使用 [[R&S CMX500]] mobile radio tester，作為 NG eCall voice and data transmission 的 comprehensive testing solution。
- 來源稱測試模擬 [[PSAP]]，並驗證 implementation at both ends with the [[EN 17240]]:2024 standard。
- 來源說 [[R&S CMX500]] 支援 4G 與 5G technologies，目標是讓方案 future-proof。
- [[Juergen Meyer]] 以 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] Vice President Market Segment Automotive 身分在新聞稿中引述，稱此次 collaboration 為 future emergency call services 建立 new benchmark。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMX-KA098]] software option 可在 realistic network conditions 下用於 NG eCall testing。
- 來源將合作定位為 mutually validating solutions、reducing effort、accelerating time to market for mutual customers。
- Press and media contact 為 [[Patrizia Muehlbauer]]，職稱 PR Manager Products & Standard Systems。
- 公司資訊段落稱 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 2024/2025 fiscal year net revenue 為 EUR 3.16 billion，2025-06-30 worldwide employees more than 15,000。

Hybrid eCall testing › 測試目的
依 [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]]，hybrid eCall test specification [[EN 18052]] 要求 hybrid system combine different transmission paths and protocols，確保 eCall reliably reaches its destination。

來源描述的實務語境：

- 車輛使用 NG eCall functions，即 IP/IMS-based voice and data over 4G/5G。
- 當 coverage 或 service quality degrades 時，車輛可 automatically fall back to available classic CS eCall 2G/3G transport paths。
- Manufacturers 需要 validate hybrid implementations，以確保能 trigger calls、transmit [[MSD]]、maintain [[GNSS]] positioning，並提供 intelligible voice quality。

Hybrid eCall testing › 測試情境
來源明示或列出的 network scenarios 包含：

- [[VoNR]]。
- [[VoLTE]]。
- circuit-switched fallback。
- handovers。
- degraded radio conditions。
- real-world mobile network conditions simulation。
- various network scenarios emulation。

來源沒有提供各 scenario 的 test case IDs、channel model、radio profile 或 pass/fail criteria。

Hybrid eCall testing
[[Hybrid eCall testing]] 是驗證車輛 emergency call system 能在 NG eCall 與 classic CS eCall transport paths 之間可靠運作與 fallback 的測試主題；[[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]] 將其連到 [[EN 18052]]:2025、[[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026、[[R&S CMX500]] 與 [[R&S CMX-KA09x]]。
